card.name: Words leading up to strength or energy
card.fires_on: Words just before a spot where 'strength', 'strong' or 'energy' could come next, in text about coping, grief, family caregiving and hospice. It fires on verbs and linking words such as 'be', 'have', 'save', 'remained'.

modes.label: Coping and staying strong
modes.description: A verb or small word right before 'strong' or 'strength' in passages about family members coping with a loss.
modes.example: Jennifer's mother, trying to<< be>> strong, was crying.

modes.label: Saving or keeping energy
modes.description: A verb before 'energy' in self-care advice for caregivers or patients.
modes.example: Take good care of yourself so you<< have>> the energy to enjoy your child
